response.rationale: A (Hive Status) is a summary view that BeekeepingService builds about a hive, adding derived data such as the latest inspection ('latestInspection: this.latestInspection(hive.id)'). B is the Hive entity itself, which HarvestRepository.findByHive uses only as a lookup key ('findByHive(hiveId: string)'). The status describes a hive but isn't the same real-world thing as the hive. The two only share the hive ID.
